fields.label: Enable Configurator Flag Sync
fields.description: Master toggle. When unchecked, the engine emits ``is_configurable = false`` for every item regardless of the rules below — flip on after the storefront resolver is live.

fields.options: Items that match any rule below are marked configurable. Exclusion keywords are checked against item_name (case-insensitive, substring match) and act as a veto over the include rules.

fields.label: Eligible Item Groups
fields.description: Items in any listed group (and their descendants when the row's flag is set) are configurator-eligible.

fields.label: Exclusion Keywords
fields.description: Comma-separated. An item is excluded if any keyword appears in its ``item_name`` (case-insensitive). Typical: ``Zubehör, Einzelteil, Ersatzteil, Demo``.

fields.label: Respect Item.is_configurable Override
fields.description: When checked (default), an explicit ``1`` on ``Item.is_configurable`` (Customize Form custom field) wins over the rules above. The column doesn't need to exist — when absent, the engine falls back to the rules only.

fields.label: Medusa Metadata Key
fields.description: Key under ``product.metadata`` the Medusa storefront reads to decide whether to render the configurator badge. Default ``is_configurable``.

fields.label: Shopware customField Key
fields.description: Key under ``product.customFields`` for Shopware. Storefront-side convention (e.g. ``kreckler_is_configurable``); the Shopware custom-field set has to exist with the matching slot or the storefront won't see it.
